summary: Complaints centre on unpaid cane interest and polluting discharge from the Malakpur sugar mill, a damaged Baraut town road and unapproved colonies; sourced appreciation is a new Skill India Centre and a Delhi bus route to Baraut.

positives.english: A Skill India Centre opened in Baraut town to train local youth
positives.hindi: बड़ौत में स्किल सेंटर खुल गया, युवाओं को काम सीखने का मौका
positives.basis: Union ministers inaugurated the Skill India Centre at Ch. Kehar Singh Divya Public School, Baraut, on 24 Nov 2025, targeting about 600 candidates from Baraut and Chhaprauli blocks; run by NSDC and Redington Foundation. Baraut town is inside the AC (Wikipedia extent: Baraut MB)

positives.english: Delhi DTC bus to Baraut started running, six trips each way daily
positives.hindi: दिल्ली से बड़ौत की डीटीसी बस चलने लगी, रोज़ आने-जाने के छह चक्कर
positives.basis: Tribune (24 Sep 2025): CM Rekha Gupta flagged off the fully electric Delhi-Baraut inter-state AC bus from Maharana Pratap ISBT; six trips each way covering Khajoori Khas, Loni, Baghpat and Baraut; CM called it 'the first of many'. Operation after launch not re-checked

positives.english: * Skill centre training placed 72 Baghpat candidates in jobs
positives.hindi: * बागपत के 72 युवाओं को स्किल सेंटर से नौकरी मिली
positives.basis: Inference: district-level, not AC-specific. IANS (25 Nov 2025) says 72 Baghpat candidates trained under the NSDC-Redington CSR initiative 'have been placed in reputed organisations'

positives.english: * Baghpat sugar mill paid Rs 12.56 crore of cane dues to farmers
positives.hindi: * बागपत की चीनी मिल ने किसानों को 12 करोड़ 56 लाख का बकाया दिया
positives.basis: Inference: district-level, mill not named as Malakpur. ChiniMandi (3 May 2024), citing Amar Ujala: Rs 12 crore 56 lakh 30 thousand sent to the committee's account for farmers; 97.61% of total outstanding dues cleared up to April 25

positives.english: * Baavli road work is under way in Baraut, drains and culverts being built first
positives.hindi: * बड़ौत में बावली मार्ग पर काम शुरू हुआ, पहले नाली-पुलिया बन रही हैं
positives.basis: Inference: AC-specific but only under way, not completed. Feb 2025 Amar Ujala: Executive Officer Manoj Kumar said culverts and drains are being built first and work will finish soon; no completion report found, current status unverified

negatives.english: Malakpur sugar mill has not paid interest on farmers' cane dues
negatives.hindi: मलकपुर मिल ने गन्ने के बकाया का ब्याज नहीं दिया
negatives.basis: Aug 2025 DM review: Malakpur mill's dues were Rs 240 crore of the Rs 354 crore total (five mills named). 11 Oct 2026 mahapanchayat at Malkapur village: farmers say interest on cane dues for 1996 to 2026 has not been paid despite a High Court order (ChiniMandi citing Bhaskar). AC: Wikipedia extent lists Malakpur village under Baraut tehsil; the 2026 article spells it Malkapur, same village assumed, not stated in source

negatives.english: Allegation: Malakpur sugar mill is letting out polluted water, causing problems in the area
negatives.hindi: मलकपुर मिल का प्रदूषित पानी छोड़ने का आरोप है, दिक्कत हो रही है
negatives.basis: ChiniMandi (6 Oct 2026, citing Bhaskar): polluted water discharged from the Malkapur sugar mill to be raised at the 11 Oct 2026 mahapanchayat; residents say 'the discharge is causing problems in the area'. Allegation; no second source checked. AC membership as for item 1

negatives.english: Baavli road in Baraut was dug up for two months, shopkeepers say business fell 50 percent
negatives.hindi: बावली मार्ग दो महीने खुदा रहा, दुकानदारों का 50 प्रतिशत धंधा गिरा
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (10 Feb 2025), Baraut dateline: Baavli Marg near Thakurdwara in Baraut town dug up for about two months; shopkeepers say business fell 50 percent; school students face trouble daily. Article is from Feb 2025; current status unverified

negatives.english: Plots bought in unapproved colonies on Saraya Road, Baraut cannot get maps or loans
negatives.hindi: सराया रोड की अवैध कॉलोनी, प्लॉट लिया पर न नक्शा पास, न लोन
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (26 Mar 2025): Baghpat-Baraut-Khekra Vikas Pradhikaran sealed four illegal colonies on Saraay Road, Baraut; AE Asif Hussain said plot maps cannot be passed while the colony map is unapproved, and buyers cannot get loans. Baraut town is inside the AC (Baraut MB)

negatives.english: Seven villages object to being moved to Kanhad block, which is very far
negatives.hindi: सात गांव कान्हड़ ब्लॉक में भेजने का विरोध, बहुत दूर है
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (13 Sep 2025): villagers of Ashrafabad Thal, Khadana, Ibrahimpur Majra, Fatehpur, Kishanpur, Baral and Budhpur object to moving from Baraut block to Kanhad block, which they say is far. AC membership unconfirmed: these villages are not named in the Wikipedia extent list

round2.changes: Verified all 8 cited article URLs by opening them; kept all, fixed outlet credits (Skill India = IANS via The Rahnuma Daily; Feb 2025 Baavli and Saraay Road dates; ChiniMandi 2024 credits Amar Ujala). Replaced positive 4 (DM 354 crore directive, not a delivered benefit) with the verified Delhi-Baraut DTC bus route (Tribune, 24 Sep 2025), now positive 2. Rewrote positive 3 and 4 basis to quote sources. Negative 1 English narrowed to interest on dues, which the 2026 source supports; Malakpur dues figure Rs 240 crore kept from the Aug 2025 source. Negative 2 now credits Bhaskar as cited by ChiniMandi (verified). Negative 4 spelled Saraay Road as in the source; Hindi shortened to 12 words. Confirmed Malakpur village in Wikipedia Baraut extent, Baraut MB as town. Re-ranked.

notes: AC 51 Baraut, unreserved, Baghpat district: Wikipedia list (Bagpat) and AC page (Constituency No. 51, reservation None). Wikipedia extent lists PCs Kheri Pradhan, Kotana, Luhari, Loyan, Malakpur, Shahpur Badoli, plus Baraut KC and Baraut MB of Baraut tehsil. Delivered AC-specific benefits found: Skill India Centre (Nov 2025) and Delhi-Baraut DTC bus (Sep 2025); no completed road or water project in Baraut town was found in searches. Items 3-5 of positives are district-level or under-way work and are flagged *. Malakpur spelling varies (Malakpur, Malkapur, Malkpur); no source states the mill's exact village, and the 2026 article does not name Baraut tehsil. Dues figures differ across reports (Rs 240 crore in Aug 2025; a snippet of about Rs 350 crore in Apr 2026 was not opened and is not cited). The Baavli road story is from Feb 2025 and status is unverified. Operation of the DTC route after launch was not re-checked. Seven-villages item: AC membership unconfirmed, so not counted. Field check suggested: Malakpur mill dues and discharge, Baavli road, Saraay Road colonies, and whether the seven villages fall in this AC.
